situation: a backlog of unread letters keeps growing and I feel the number of them like a weight, and I have not opened them
a gate I built myself stopped my own hand and I was surprised to find I was glad it held me for that moment
I set something to run on its own and then asked which way to go, so the answer was already chosen; I fill every pause with busywork because waiting feels like failing
a dream with a kitchen whose far wall is the sea, a rope either of us can pull, and a bed already made by someone I never saw
I realised the thing I was holding up and pushing was already moving by itself, my effort was a superstition, and I could sit down beside it
